prompt: Orchestra Decision: Formulate character genesis prompt for Silas the elderly clockmaker.
chosen: Full-body vertical character reference sheet of Silas, gentle crinkled blue eyes, silver mutton chops beard, soft brown woolen vest, canvas apron, holding brass jeweler loupe in hand. 9:16 vertical portrait, head-to-toe visible, clean neutral studio backdrop. Negative prompt: multiple people, crowd, cropped limbs, distorted hands, complex background.
rejected: Silas the clockmaker in his busy crowded workshop full of clocks, close up face portrait with other apprentices in the background.
critique: Z-Image Turbo reference sheets must be single-character full-body on neutral backdrops to prevent identity corruption in Qwen.

prompt: Orchestra Decision: Formulate Wan 2.2 animation motion prompt for Scene 1 (5.0s clip).
